Bevel map

fe-bevel-map is a special filter / image generator, used as a source for fe-displacement-map to generate effect of liquid glass

parameters:

bevel-size
bevel width - width of transition from border to grey area in the middle, can be interpretted as elevation;
bevel-curve
shape of the bevel, one of:
  • linear
  • quad
  • cubic
  • quart
  • quint
  • circular

dimensions and border-radius are taken from the element this fillter is applied to.
